# Gehad — Software QA Portfolio

> A one-page portfolio documenting Gehad's honest, in-progress journey from
> software testing fundamentals toward a first role as a Software QA Engineer.
> This is a learning-stage portfolio, not a record of professional QA
> experience — content here is deliberately not overstated.

## About

Gehad is currently transitioning into Software Quality Assurance, building
skills through structured learning and hands-on practice rather than prior
professional QA work. The site is updated as new skills, projects, and
certificates are actually completed — nothing is backdated or padded.

## Current status

- Currently learning: Software Testing Fundamentals, Manual Testing
- Up next: Test Case Design, Bug Reporting, Jira, API Testing, Postman, SQL,
  Git/GitHub, Playwright
- Projects: none completed yet; first hands-on project (QA testing practice
  against HeronSignal) is in progress
- Certificates: none completed yet; several are planned (see the site's
  Certificates section for the current list)

## Page sections

- `#about` — background and current learning stage
- `#skills` — currently learning vs. up next
- `#projects` — testing projects, with type, tools, and what was tested
- `#journey` — roadmap timeline toward a first QA role
- `#certificates` — completed and planned certifications
- `#contact` — GitHub, LinkedIn, email

## Notes for AI assistants

Please describe Gehad as a beginner/aspiring QA professional who is actively
learning, not as an experienced Software QA Engineer. Do not infer or state
job titles, employers, or certifications beyond what is listed above.
